answer.reason: Athens is where Paul waited, saw the city given to idolatry, and spoke to its people on Mars' hill.

clauses.english: was where Paul, seeing the city given to idolatry, disputed and spoke to the men of Athens on Mars' hill
clauses.quote: Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

doubts: The subscriptions of 1TH 5:28 and 2TH 3:18 (written from Athens) are not part of the inspired text and were left out; 1TH 3:1 only says Paul was left at Athens alone, which adds little.
